cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to peel potatoes, and I'm still faster. First to finish five chooses dinner; I'm on four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want pizza. We can get it free with this voucher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to compare prices. My potatoes are already here: free as well. Now compare preparation times.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The pizza arrives in ten minutes. Yours aren't even boiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then taste decides. I'll cook mine the way I taught you; Mum can judge. She's been asking me to make them all week.

reason: Make A retain teacher superiority by moving from speed to price to preparation and finally favored taste after B supplies a faster free alternative.
